title: Figure 1: Paschen Curve for Air – Breakdown Voltage vs. Pressure x Gap
description: Log-log line plot titled "Breakdown Voltage vs. Pressure x Gap (Air)" showing breakdown voltage in volts (100 to 100,000) against pressure x gap in Torr-inches (1.00E-02 to 1.00E+04). The curve falls to a minimum of a few hundred volts near 0.1 to 1 Torr-inch and then rises steeply. It appears on page 13 of a report on high-power microwave (HPM) pulsed-power switching, with the caption "Figure 1. Paschen Curve for Air."
